newImport.templateHint: The template has one sheet per section with the expected columns. Employee codes are formatted as text so leading zeros are kept. Exports from other systems can be mapped instead.

validate.description: Validation is a dry run: every row is checked against the same rules as the employee screens, and nothing is written. You can validate as often as you need.
validate.running: Validating… this can take a few minutes for large files
validate.failedNote: Correct the errors in the workbook and upload it again, skip rows you do not want to import, take a decision on possible duplicates, or have unfamiliar labels mapped. Then validate again.

results.title: Validation results
results.skippedNote: Skipped by decision: {{skipped}} · blank rows ignored: {{blank}} · repeated header rows ignored: {{headers}}

skip.title: Skip this row
skip.description: {{sheet}} row {{row}} will not be imported. It stays in the import history with your reason.

distinct.title: Confirm a different person
distinct.description: {{sheet}} row {{row}} looks like an existing employee or another row (same name and joining date). Confirm only if you have checked that it is a different person.

decisionDialog.reasonMissing: Enter the reason for skipping this row.
decisionDialog.revalidateNote: After a decision the file must be validated again before it can be approved.

approve.title: Approve and import
approve.description: Check the preview below. When you approve, every row is checked again against the current data and written in one transaction: either everything is imported or nothing is.
approve.summaryCaption: Rows to import by section and outcome
approve.applyUpdates_one: Also apply the listed corrections to {{count}} existing record
approve.applyUpdates_other: Also apply the listed corrections to {{count}} existing records
approve.applyUpdatesHint: Without this, rows that would change existing employees are skipped. Employment status and separations are never changed by an import.
approve.reviewed: I have reviewed the preview and the issues, and I approve this import.
approve.committing: Importing… do not close this page
approve.recheckNote: If the data changed since validation or the preview is too old, you will be asked to validate again.
approve.noPermission: You can review this import, but approving it needs the import approval permission.

result.failedBody: A row no longer passed the checks when the import was approved, so the whole import was rolled back. The rows with problems are listed below. Correct the data and start a new import.
result.expiredBody: This import was not completed in time. The uploaded file has been deleted; start a new import if it is still needed.
result.cancelledBody: This import was cancelled. Nothing was written, and the uploaded file has been deleted.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this import?

issues.employee_code_numeric: The employee code is stored as a number, so leading zeros may have been lost. Format the column as text and enter the code exactly.
issues.date_invalid: This is not a valid date.
issues.date_ambiguous: The year has two digits, so the date is ambiguous. Use a four-digit year.
issues.date_numeric: The date is a plain number. Enter it as a date (for example 01-04-2025).
issues.date_has_time: The date includes a time of day. Enter the date only.
issues.status_invalid: Unknown employment status. Use Active, On Leave or Separated, or leave it blank.
issues.language_invalid: Unknown language. Use English, Bengali, Hindi or Gujarati.
issues.assignment_type_invalid: Unknown assignment type. Use Primary, Additional, Acting or Deputation.
issues.email_invalid: This is not a valid email address.
issues.value_too_long: The value is too long (at most {{max}} characters).
issues.last_day_before_start: The last day is before the start date.
issues.last_working_day_requires_separated: A last working day is given, but the status is not Separated.
issues.separated_requires_last_working_day: The status is Separated, but no last working day is given.
issues.row_hidden: This row is hidden in the workbook. Check that it should be imported.
issues.row_merged_cells: This row contains merged cells. Check that the values are in the right columns.
issues.duplicate_in_file: The same record appears more than once in the file ({{rows}}).
issues.probable_duplicate: Possible duplicate: same name and joining date as employee code(s) {{codes}}. Confirm a different person or skip the row.
issues.depends_on_invalid_row: This row depends on another row that has errors.
issues.reference_unmapped: This label does not match a record exactly. It has been added to the reference mapping queue.
issues.employee_not_found: No employee with this code exists in the LMS or in the file.
issues.manager_not_found: The manager's employee code does not exist in the LMS or in the file.
issues.assignment_conflicts_existing: This assignment conflicts with the employee's existing assignment history. Imports never rewrite history; correct it on the employee's profile.
issues.reporting_conflicts_existing: This reporting line conflicts with the employee's existing reporting history.
issues.status_change_not_applied: The employment status in the file differs from the LMS. Imports never change status; change it on the employee's profile.
issues.separation_not_applied: The file gives a separation date. Imports never separate employees; use the separation workflow on the employee's profile.
issues.unit_type_not_assignable: Employees are not normally assigned to units of this type.

codes.import_profile_not_found: This import profile does not exist.
codes.import_row_not_found: This row is not part of the import.
codes.import_mapping_not_found: This reference mapping does not exist.
codes.import_invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the import's current state. Reload to see the latest state.
codes.import_profile_unavailable: This import profile version is no longer available.
codes.import_not_ready: This import is not ready for approval (it may already have been approved or changed).
codes.import_preview_expired: The preview is too old. Validate again before approving.
codes.import_revalidation_required: Reference mappings changed after validation. Validate again before approving.
codes.import_mapping_already_decided: Someone else has already decided this mapping.
codes.import_mapping_not_decided: This mapping has no decision to withdraw.
codes.import_file_unavailable: The uploaded file is no longer available. Start a new import.
codes.import_job_expired: This import has expired. Upload the workbook again to start a new import.
codes.import_records_changed: Employee records changed after validation, so the preview no longer matches. Validate again before approving.
codes.import_too_many_rows: This workbook has more rows than can be processed in one import. Split it into smaller workbooks (for example, employees first, then assignments and reporting lines).
codes.import_storage_unavailable: The uploaded file could not be stored. Try again later or contact the system administrator.
codes.version_conflict: Someone else changed this import. Reload and try again.
codes.file_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
codes.file_type_not_allowed: Upload the workbook as an .xlsx file.
codes.file_encrypted_or_legacy: The file is password-protected or in the old .xls format. Save it as an unprotected .xlsx workbook.
codes.file_not_xlsx: The file is not an Excel workbook.
codes.file_corrupted: The file is damaged and cannot be read.
codes.file_macro_enabled: The workbook contains macros, which are not accepted. Save it as a normal .xlsx workbook.
codes.file_unsafe_entry: The file contains unsafe content and was rejected.
codes.file_expansion_limit: The file expands to too much data and was rejected.
codes.file_too_complex: The file has too many internal parts and was rejected.
codes.file_too_many_sheets: The workbook has too many worksheets.
codes.sheet_too_many_rows: A worksheet has more rows than the import limit. Split the file.
codes.sheet_too_many_columns: A worksheet has more columns than the import limit.
codes.import_mapping_empty: Map at least one worksheet section.
codes.import_mapping_unknown_section: A mapped section is not part of this profile.
codes.import_mapping_unknown_sheet: A mapped worksheet does not exist in the file.
codes.import_mapping_duplicate_section: The same section is mapped twice on one worksheet.
codes.import_mapping_header_row: The header row could not be read.
codes.import_mapping_unknown_field: A column is mapped to a field that this section does not have.
codes.import_mapping_field_twice: A field is mapped to more than one column.
codes.import_mapping_unknown_column: A mapped column does not exist on the worksheet.
codes.import_decision_invalid: This decision is not possible for this row.
codes.import_skip_reason_required: Enter a reason for skipping the row.
codes.import_mapping_target_not_found: The chosen record does not exist.
codes.import_mapping_target_inactive: The chosen record is not active.
codes.invalid_cursor: The list position is no longer valid. Reload the list.
codes.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
